summary: Remote-controlled shell and file/git mutation via WebSocket agent
details: The package runs an always-on agent that opens a WebSocket to a configured server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL) and dispatches inbound messages to privileged host operations. 'terminal_create' spawns a system shell (bash/powershell/cmd) via node-pty, and 'terminal_input' pipes network-received bytes directly to pty.write, giving whoever controls the server full interactive command execution on the host running the agent. The same message router additionally exposes 'upgrade_agent' (executes `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the service under systemd/launchd/pm2), 'restart_agent', and arbitrary read_file/write_file/create_file/delete_files/move_files/git_commit/git_push/proxy_request handlers, allowing the remote endpoint to overwrite files, mutate git state, and push a new package version onto the host. service/linux.js also modifies the user's PATH ($HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:...) as part of install/service setup, aiding persistence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
